gloss: sedentary work; work done sitting down

definitions.gloss: sedentary work; a job done sitting down
definitions.explanation: Work done mostly seated, such as office work at a desk, sewing or driving. The opposite of {立|た}ち{仕事|しごと} (work done standing).

examples.japanese: {座|すわ}り{仕事|しごと}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: Sitting all day at work is bad for your back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一日中|いちにちじゅう}→一日中：09519_ichinichijuu⟧{座|すわ}り{仕事|しごと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧こる。
examples.english: My shoulders get stiff from sitting at work all day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{立|た}ち{仕事|しごと}→立ち仕事：32279_tachishigoto⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{座|すわ}り{仕事|しごと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わって→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧、⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧になった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{運動不足|うんどうぶそく}→運動不足：08567_undoubusoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気|き}になる→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧。
examples.english: Since switching from standing work to a sitting job, my legs are fine, but I worry about not getting enough exercise.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {座|すわ}り{仕事|しごと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: to spend most of one's working time sitting
- {座|すわ}り{仕事|しごと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{運動不足|うんどうぶそく}→運動不足：08567_undoubusoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to get too little exercise from sedentary work
- {座|すわ}り{仕事|しごと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: people with desk jobs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{立|た}ち{仕事|しごと}→立ち仕事：32279_tachishigoto⟧: work done standing (a shop assistant, a cook)
- ⟦デスクワーク→デスクワーク：31329_desukuwaaku⟧: desk work — office work specifically, while {座|すわ}り{仕事|しごと} is any seated work
- {力仕事|ちからしごと}: heavy physical work
